views.rationale: AAPL's Americas net sales increased 20% YoY, while AMZN's net sales increased 39% YoY.
CAT's sales increased 23% YoY, while CVX's sales decreased 1% YoY.

GOOGL's revenue growth of 26% year over year, constant currency revenue growth of 23% year over year, outpaces GS's net revenues in equities client execution essentially unchanged compared with the second quarter of 2017.
KO's net operating revenues increased 2% versus 2017, driven by volume growth, partially offset by a decline in price, product and geographic mix.

MSFT's revenue increased 14% versus 2017, driven by growth in Windows, Search advertising, and Gaming, compared to JNJ's sales to customers analysis of consolidated sales for the first fiscal six months of 2018, worldwide sales were $40.8 billion, a total increase of 11.6%.
NVDA's operating expenses increased 6% year-over-year, while NEE's operating expenses decreased $80 million.
PG's gross margin decreased 130 basis points to 48.7% of net sales in 2018.
UNH's revenue increased 4.2% year-over-year, while WMT's revenue increased 4.3% year-over-year.
